scope: Phase 10 explicit artifact and output development scenarios

checks.name: Artifact route starts empty and disconnected without production fixtures
Explicit registration preserves separate worker and Manager models
Standard workers share geometry and materials with independent skeletons
Imported input is linked before execution and never claimed as worker output
Existing deterministic worker navigation, seated work and headband remain intact
Manager coordinates calmly without working-hard or any headband
Worker exact mesh selection and camera focus are preserved
Tool writes immutable bytes without automatically creating an output artifact
Explicit registration records real tool execution/task/agent provenance
Artifact integrity descriptor matches the actual immutable write receipt
Task input/output links are distinct canonical artifact IDs
Completed task and completed artifact remain unverified while QA pending
Actual immutable v1 contents fail required QA and bind original hash/version
QA failure evidence references genuine inspected bytes and a failed assertion
Failure creates traceable canonical repair and Manager attention
QA failure is reflected by the existing blocked worker indicator
Repair uses capability assignment and canonical repair state
Actual repair creates v2 with new byte identity and repair provenance
v1 metadata/hash and initial QA failure remain inspectable after supersession
New QA recheck reads v2 and records separate passing evidence
Only successful QA verifies v2; historical v1 never becomes verified
Manager completes after required verified output and returns real artifact record
Artifact changes use canonical events and activity history
Selected task context shows versions, provenance, hash and QA without full content
No artifact or QA action silently creates memory
Manager exact selection and camera focus remain headband-free
Open-top company overview reset remains available
Idle artifact state introduces no polling, commands or commits
One verified artifact cannot satisfy a structured two-output requirement
Two separate artifacts are independently verified and returned by Manager
Missing expected output produces Manager attention with no fabricated artifact
Simple output completion does not imply QA verification
Unrelated worker cannot retrieve private output
Manager context cannot recover private artifact content identity through source tool events
Selected unrelated worker sees restricted metadata context without hash
Phase 8 nested credential policy rejects artifact metadata without mutation or leakage
Ordinary artifact update cannot fabricate verification
Manager remains dedicated and headband-free throughout scenario resets
Shared asset cache loads each canonical GLB once across resets
No console/page errors, failed requests or hot reloads
Validated source hashes stayed unchanged throughout acceptance

limitations: Session-local bounded UTF-8 development document tools; no production storage, external providers or unrestricted downloads.
Headless Chromium software rendering is not an RTX hardware benchmark.
Phase 8 pattern-based credential checks and authorized verification assertion limitations remain.
